name: Yuuto Ayscuros Neats
original_name: ユウト・アイスキュロス・ニーツ
source:
Prince of a central country in the other world.
His age is unknown, a sorrowful prince who has lived a long time.
He lives in his castle with his subordinates and rarely leaves.
